paite: Aigupta gam a pan Israelte apawt ua, Jakob inkuanpihte melmak mi lak a kipan apawt lai un.
heading: Paikan Ankuangluina La

paite: Judah a mun siangthou ahi a, Israelte avaihawmna gam ahong hita hi.
Tuipi in huai amu a, ataimang a; Jordan lui kiksak in a-omta hi.
Tangte belamtal bang in adiang ua, mual neute belampa noute bang in.
Aw nang tuipi, bang na chi a, na taimang tak? Nang Jordan, bangchi na hia, na kik nawn tak?
Nou tangte aw, bang na chi ua ahia, belampa noute bang a na dian uh?
Nang leitung, TOUPA ma ah ling in, Jakobte Pathian ma ah.
Ama'n suangpi dil asuaksak a, meisuang tui nak asuaksak hi.
